beliefs: Outer branch |x|>=2 has form f(x) = -sign(x)*A*|x|^p*exp(k*|x|) with A,p,k fit to positive-side magnitudes [E1, E7, E10, E15, E17]
Outer branch is NOT exactly odd: negative side magnitudes are larger than positive side at moderate |x|, converging to the same values at large |x| [E10, E12, E13, E14, E16, E18]
At |x|>=~48 the two sides agree (f(-x)=-f(x)) to observed precision [E16, E18]
Negative-side outer magnitudes exceed positive-side by a factor decaying from ~2.3 at |x|=2.5 to ~1 at |x|>=48 [E10, E14, E16, E18]
f(2)=-60.2 and f(-2)=-67.0 exactly; outer law is only approximate near |x|=2 [E1, E4, E6]
On (0,1) f is exactly 0, with a sharp step to -4.3 at x=1.0 [E5, E9]
On (1,2) f rises smoothly from -4.3 toward ~-30 as x->2- [E3, E4, E5, E9]
On (-2,0) f is a smooth curve: ~+6 near -1, peaking ~+8 near -1.2, then dropping steeply to -67 at x=-2 [E3, E6]
Outer sign is negative for positive x, positive for negative x [E1, E7, E10, E14, E16, E18]
Positive-side near-boundary magnitudes (2-4.5) are larger than the global log-linear fit predicts; a local correction factor applies [E15, E17]
Negative-side near-boundary magnitudes (2-4.5) are larger still than positive side by a decaying ratio [E14]
The outer law is smooth and monotone in |x|; a single global fit plus side-ratio correction reproduces all sampled points to ~1% [E17, E18]

The outer branch is CONTINUOUS through x=2: f(2.0001)=-60.21, f(2.001)=-60.31, f(2.01)=-61.26, f(2.05)=-65.67, f(2.1)=-71.56, so f(2)=-60.2 is not a special case but the start of the outer branch [E19]
The inner branch on (1,2) approaches ~-30 as x->2- but the outer branch starts at -60.2 at x=2, so there is a genuine jump discontinuity at x=2 (from ~-30 to -60.2) [E19]
notes: E19 shows the outer branch is continuous through x=2 (f(2.0001)=-60.21 etc.), so the -60.2 special case was wrong: it is just the outer value at x=2. The inner (1,2) branch ends near -30, giving a real jump at x=2. I extended the positive outer correction table to include 2.0-2.1 smoothly and removed the special-case at x=2.0.
